args.text: Ride along with car B: A creeps ahead only at the difference of the two speeds.

stem: Car A drives east at {{vA}} m/s and car B drives east at {{vB}} m/s on a straight road.
What is the velocity of A relative to B (east positive)?

hints.text: Imagine riding in car B. How fast does A move away from you?

relative-added.text: Both cars move the same way, so B sees A pulling ahead only by the difference of their speeds.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a velocity.

generic.text: Relative velocity of A with respect to B is v_A − v_B.

workedSolution.text: = {{vA}} − {{vB}} = {{ans}} m/s: A pulls ahead at {{ans}} m/s.

relative-added.front: Velocity of A relative to B, both moving the same way?
